text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PAGER -> High 5xx rate detected on route /v1/chat (us-east-1). error_rate=6.2% over 12m, spike correlated with high token throughput from multiple API keys. Triggered at 2024-10-12 02:31 UTC. Severity: P1.

Jun Park: i'm on it — paging on-call. @Toni R. are you around to take lead?

Toni R.: i'm available, taking lead. first step: live mitigation to protect platform. plan to tighten per-endpoint quotas (chat first), throttle anonymous traffic, and enable rerank fallback. @Samir can you apply immediate quota changes for chat?

Samir: on it. applying conservative per-key RPS reduction and short-duration quota to avoid long customer impact. running admin call now: 

```
POST https://internal-admin.redwood/quotas/update
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "route": "/v1/chat",
  "scope": "per_api_key",
  "rps": 10,
  "duration": "30m",
  "note": "emergency throttle - oncall Toni R."
}
```

Samir: quota update complete — per-key rps for /v1/chat in us-east set to 10 for 30m. rolling window enforced. :white_check_mark:

Maya: i'm seeing embeddings calls spiking from a handful of IP ranges too. putting a temporary network rule to deprioritize and lowering embedding bursts: 

- embeddings per-key burst -> 5rps
- block list for suspicious CIDRs added (temporary)

Elena (CS): contacting top-impacted customer edu-saas now to notify them of throttling and request rate pattern. will escalate if they report high customer impact.

Toni R.: also enabling route-specific circuit breaker on rerank to fail-open to smaller model to reduce retries. config: 

```
rbctl circuit-breaker set --route "/v1/rerank" --error-rate 10% --window 1m --fallback-model "rerank-small-v1"
```

Samir: circuit breaker enabled. logs indicate two main error classes: model-timeout and kernel OOM during peak batching. fallback model is smaller and should avoid OOMs.

Jun Park: adding a traffic-shaper rule to deprioritize unauthenticated requests to /v1/chat in us-east: 

```
traffic-shaper set-priority --region us-east --route "/v1/chat" --auth "missing" --priority low --duration 20m
```

Samir: confirming applied. also toggled a temporary global rate-limit for new API keys to stop bursty onboarding scripts.

Maya: dashboards updated — error rate down from 6.2% -> 2.1% in last 6m; tokens/sec reduced ~35%. still watching memory and kernel OOM traces.

Toni R.: operational plan: keep emergency quotas in place for 30m, monitor for 30m-1h, then gradual rollback if stable. Jun, can you take the 4-hour watch after i hand off?

Jun Park: ack — i'll take watch. if stable at T+30m, i'll begin staged rollback: 25% increments every 10m while watching error rate and OOM traces.

Elena (CS): i'll send a customer update to edu-saas and notify support to expect tickets. will provide ETA and mitigation summary.

Samir: added short incident note to the admin timeline with the quota change request id: rq_834920. Keeping the emergency rule pinned.

Toni R.: handing off to @Jun Park for watch. anyone else? thumbs if you saw this and are good with mitigation. :thumbsup: 

Jun Park: confirmed. i'll post updates every 20m and escalate if error rate creeps above 4%.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by Toni R. | Pager cleared for now. Next automated check in 10m.

[system-note] Jun Park started incident-watch shift at 2024-10-12 02:41 UTC.

[logs-snippet] Recent admin commands: 
- quotas/update (route=/v1/chat, rps=10, scope=per_api_key)
- traffic-shaper set-priority (auth=missing, priority=low)
- circuit-breaker set (route=/v1/rerank, fallback=rerank-small-v1)

Maya: monitoring -> CPU and GPU memory trending down. will keep fingers on dashboards and post if anything regresses.

Jun Park: closing loop — will keep watch and coordinate rollback once stable.

Elena (CS): continuing customer comms. will update incident thread with customer impact notes.

Toni R.: thanks all. good quick coordination. :pray:
